description: Variance Table puts actuals, prior year, plan and forecast side by side with the variances drawn right in the table, so you see what is over or under target at a glance. Key features • Actual, Previous Year, Plan and Forecast columns in one table • Variance bars (ΔPY, ΔPL) and percentage markers (ΔPY %, ΔPL %), green for favorable and red for unfavorable • Act % of Plan column with a target line and red / amber / green thresholds • Invert variance colors for cost lines, where lower is better • Multi-level category hierarchy with expand / collapse and drill-down • Extra measures with an automatic % of Total column • Auto-Fit: shrinks text, compacts the layout and hides charts so the table fits any visual size • Drag to resize and reorder columns, double-click to rename headers, click headers to sort; your layout is saved in the report • Number formatting (full, K, M, B), decimal places and negative-number style • Cross-filtering, multi-row selection, the Power BI right-click menu and Power BI tooltips with extra tooltip measures • Total row, gridlines, row height, fonts and colors are all customizable in the format pane
